_comment: Passed to uvicorn via --log-config (Dockerfile CMD). Replaces uvicorn's default config, which attaches its own plain-text handlers with propagate=false -- those handlers would bypass the app's formatter and mix a second format into the stream (docs/logging/spec.md). Here every uvicorn logger propagates to the root handler that app/core/logging.py configures when the application is imported. Lines uvicorn emits before that import fall back to logging.lastResort on stderr.
